beats.say: Alexander Volkanovski makes UFC history with ninth title win at UFC 333.
The Australian stopped Movsar Evloev in the main event at Etihad Arena Abu Dhabi on 24 October 2026 to claim a record ninth featherweight title defence.
In the co main event Petr Yan defended his bantamweight belt with a unanimous decision over Merab Dvalishvili.
Two world title defences on one card highlights the strength of the current UFC roster across divisions.
Earlier Lone'er Kavanagh delivered a stunning first round stoppage against Ramazan Temirov to open the main card in style.
Volkanovski now holds the outright UFC record with nine featherweight title wins. Which moment from UFC 333 will you replay first?

facts: Alexander Volkanovski defeated Movsar Evloev at UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi.
UFC 333 took place on 24 October 2026 at the Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
Petr Yan defeated Merab Dvalishvili in the co-main event to defend his bantamweight title.
Lone'er Kavanagh secured a first-round stoppage win against Ramazan Temirov.
Volkanovski now has the most featherweight title wins in UFC history (9).
